name: Johnsoncab Electricals
summary: Johnsoncab Electricals makes low-voltage wires and cables up to 1.1 kV under the JOHNSON CABLES brand from two units in Mehsana, Gujarat, selling to private and government customers through tenders and vendor approvals. Revenue grew from ₹89 cr in FY24 to ₹211 cr in FY26 and profit rose 146% in FY26 to ₹13.4 cr, but operating cash flow was negative ₹19.7 cr in FY26 and borrowings more than doubled to ₹79.9 cr, a debt to equity of 2.54. The whole ₹56 cr issue is fresh money, about half of it for a new shed, machinery and a rooftop solar plant and ₹14 cr for working capital, with nothing for debt repayment. At the upper band the post-issue P/E is about 15.8x, below the 18.1x median of the listed peers named in the offer documents.

drivers.name: Profit growth (RHP)
drivers.detail: Profit after tax grew 145.8% in the latest year in the RHP.

drivers.name: All 33 checks
drivers.detail: Financial health, governance, issue structure, use of proceeds, legal and risk checks.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Total income rose from ₹88.95 cr (FY24) to ₹211.34 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 54.1%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹88.95 cr, ₹140.00 cr, ₹211.34 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was 2.54 in FY26 (borrowings ₹79.88 cr vs net worth ₹31.44 cr).

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings rose about 143% (₹32.81 cr to ₹79.88 cr) while total income rose about 138% over FY24–FY26.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹8.88 cr, ₹14.24 cr, ₹31.44 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow was negative ₹19.70 cr in FY26, against a profit of ₹13.42 cr.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax grew about 146% in FY26, from ₹5.46 cr to ₹13.42 cr.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: Net margin improved from about 2.8% (FY24) to 3.9% (FY25) and 6.4% (FY26).

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: Return on net worth was 42.68% in FY26 (ROE 58.75%), helped by the small equity base and high borrowing.

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 39.68% in FY26.

checks.name: Margin vs listed peers
checks.finding: Peer margins were not found in public sources.

checks.name: P/E vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue P/E of about 15.8x (₹211.42 cr market cap vs ₹13.42 cr FY26 profit) vs a peer median of 18.1x (JD Cables 11.6x, Susan Electricals 18.1x, Prime Cable 25.5x).

checks.name: Price to book vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue price to book of about 2.4x (₹211.42 cr market cap vs about ₹87.5 cr net worth after the ₹56 cr issue) vs a peer median of 5.2x.

checks.name: Market cap to sales vs listed peers
checks.finding: Peer market cap to sales figures were not found in public sources.

checks.name: Recent pre-IPO share price
checks.finding: Rights issues in January and March 2026 allotted 2,70,000 shares at ₹140, 30% below the ₹200 upper band.

checks.name: Promoter holding after the issue
checks.finding: Promoters hold about 73.5% after the issue, down from 100%.

checks.name: No pledged promoter shares
checks.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

checks.name: Related-party transactions
checks.finding: Total related-party transaction figures were not found; both plants are leased from promoters and promoters had lent ₹11.56 cr as of August 2026.

checks.name: No regulatory action against promoters
checks.finding: No outstanding litigation, criminal or regulatory proceedings are reported against the promoters or directors.

checks.name: Offer for sale share of the issue
checks.finding: The entire ₹56.02 cr issue is fresh; there is no offer for sale.

checks.name: Free float after listing
checks.finding: The issue is about 26.5% of the ₹211.42 cr post-issue market cap.

checks.name: Selling shareholders' cost
checks.finding: No selling shareholders, because there is no offer for sale.

checks.name: Money for growth
checks.finding: ₹28.40 cr, about 50.7% of the issue, goes to a new factory shed, machinery and a rooftop solar plant.

checks.name: Debt repayment share
checks.finding: None of the proceeds are earmarked for repaying debt.

checks.name: General corporate purposes
checks.finding: The amount set aside for general corporate purposes was not found in public sources.

checks.name: No repayment to promoter entities
checks.finding: No proceeds go to repaying loans, so none repay promoter or group-company loans.

checks.name: Litigation against the company
checks.finding: No outstanding litigation against the company is reported; amounts are nil.

checks.name: Criminal or regulatory cases
checks.finding: No criminal or regulatory cases are reported against the company, promoters or directors.

checks.name: Contingent liabilities
checks.finding: Contingent liabilities were not found in public sources.

checks.name: Customer concentration
checks.finding: Top 10 customers gave 66.24% of FY26 revenue; the largest gave 18.35%.

checks.name: Supplier dependence
checks.finding: Top 10 suppliers were 49.30% of FY26 purchases, but the largest single supplier's share was not found.

checks.name: Operating history
checks.finding: The company was incorporated in November 2020, about 6 years ago; the promoters' predecessor firm Johnson Cables dates from 2012.

checks.name: Auditor remarks
checks.finding: Auditor remarks were not found in public sources.
